caption: The drawing features a single object centered against a plain, light-colored background. The object consists of a long, brown cannon mounted on a base made of stacked, irregularly-shaped gray and beige stones. The cannon, rendered in shades of brown with subtle highlights, has a cylindrical form that widens at the base and tapers toward the open muzzle, facing left. A horizontal wooden beam, colored in various brown hues, is attached to the upper part of the cannon's mounting mechanism. Below the cannon, the stone base is detailed with shadows and different tones to represent texture and depth. To the right of the object, there is a handwritten signature in dark ink: "Marius N. Hansen."
title: Water Nozzle
